nodes.label: Two-Repo Hard Boundary (FOREIGN_TREE)
nodes.rationale: E:/BoraTradingTool (TypeScript, Claude Code) and E:/Trading_BOT (Python, OpenCode) are two trees with two owners; TREE_OWNERSHIP makes authorizeWrite return FOREIGN_TREE, and agents coordinate only through runtime/bridge/{claims,requests,responses}.

nodes.label: PriceDomain Gap (Critical)
nodes.rationale: lib/backtest/engine.ts computes (exit-entry)/entry, a ratio; the day a CONTINUOUS_ADDITIVE series reaches it every return is silently wrong; additive levels are never comparable across instruments, roll methodologies or dataset versions.

nodes.label: Reuse Not Rebuild: Feed the Existing Gauntlet
nodes.rationale: Prompt 4 must not build a validation lab; holdout firewall, trial ledger, deflated Sharpe, PBO/CSCV, ablation and promotion ladder already exist and are test-enforced in TypeScript; only unmapped items (ablation variants, matched controls, outlier dependence, window mining, regime partition, latency stress) are implemented.
